settings.layoutHeading: KEY FEATURES THAT YOUR MEMBERSHIP UNLOCKS

settings.question: Advanced Performance Metrics
settings.answer: Go beyond basic distances. Full access unlocks deeper shot analytics including dispersion patterns, launch tendencies, and consistency tracking so you can understand not just what happened, but why.

settings.question: Unlimited Shot History Storage
settings.answer: Every swing, every session, saved. Build a complete performance archive over time and track your progress without limits. Compare rounds, identify trends, and make data-backed improvements.

settings.question: Data Visualization & Immersion
settings.answer: Your data, brought to life. Interactive visuals transform raw numbers into intuitive insights with shot maps, dispersion groupings, and performance overlays that make patterns instantly clear.

settings.question: Smart Sync Across Devices
settings.answer: Seamlessly sync your shot and club data across the entire ecosystem. Whether you're using your launch monitor, GPS speaker, or app, everything works together to deliver more personalized club recommendations and smarter insights.

settings.question: Full Access to GAME Features
settings.answer: Unlock the complete GAME experience including advanced scoring, round tracking, competitive modes, and deeper analytics designed to elevate how you play and compete.

settings.question: ALL DEVICE FEATURES UNLOCKED
settings.answer: Get more out of other Blue Tees devices. Your membership will give you full access to all features, enabling richer data capture, improved integrations, and a more seamless on-course and practice experience.

settings.question: Full Course Simulation
settings.answer: Experience the course anywhere. Simulate full rounds with realistic shot tracking and course data integration, bringing a true-to-life playing experience into your practice sessions.
